in_hindi.name: सुभाश्री
in_hindi.meaning: शुभ (shubh) - auspicious, श्री (shri) - goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Subhashree in Hindi is derived from the words 'shubh' and 'shri'. Shubh means 'auspicious' and shri is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Hence, Subhashree means 'auspicious wealth' or 'auspicious beginning'.

in_marathi.name: Subhashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good news, auspicious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subha means good news, happiness and prosperity. Hrī means auspicious. So, Subhashree means 'She who brings good news, auspiciousness and happiness'.

in_bengali.name: Subhashree

in_bengali.long_meaning: Subhashree একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Subha means good news, happiness and prosperity. Hrī means auspicious. So, Subhashree means 'She who brings good news, auspiciousness and happiness'.
